overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures and supplies premium jamun seed powder for commercial formulations worldwide. Sourced across India, raw seeds undergo our disciplined six-step process comprising sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and dispatch. Operating as an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter, we maintain consistent physical specifications, low moisture levels, and uniform particle sizes for global buyers.

Our fine-milled jamun seed powder offers an 80-100 mesh profile for seamless blending across diverse manufacturing streams. Free from artificial additives, fillers, and synthetic preservatives, this botanical ingredient integrates smoothly into commercial production lines. We support commercial partners with flexible wholesale quantities starting from an MOQ of 5 kg, export documentation assistance, private label solutions, and custom processing options upon request.
highlights: Fine-milled particle size ranging from 80 to 100 mesh
Low moisture content maintained at or below 7 percent
Free from artificial additives, fillers, and synthetic preservatives
Standard 24-month shelf life under recommended storage conditions
Manufactured under a rigorous six-step quality production process
Batch traceability supported by an FSSAI-licensed facility
packaging: 25 kg bulk bags and HDPE containers
Custom private label pouches and jars
Customized export bulk packaging on request

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for jamun seed powder?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 kg, enabling flexible pilot batches, formulation testing, and large-scale bulk procurement.

faqs.q: What is the standard mesh size and moisture specification?
faqs.a: The powder is fine milled to an 80-100 mesh profile with a moisture content of 7 percent or less.

faqs.q: Do you offer private label and custom packaging services?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide OEM and private label services, including packaging in custom pouches, jars, and bulk containers.

faqs.q: Can buyers request product samples before placing bulk orders?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide product samples upon request to assist with formulation trials and commercial evaluation.

faqs.q: What export documentation support does TradeNest Naturals provide?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter, we supply comprehensive export documentation to ensure seamless international customs clearance.

faqs.q: What is the recommended storage and shelf life?
faqs.a: Store the powder in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and moisture to maintain its 24-month shelf life.
